Patient is in their mid-50s with Type 2 Diabetes and osteoarthritis. Has built a comprehensive, holistic wellness plan centered on consistent, sustainable habits. Key elements include: 
- Balanced diet(whole grains, lean proteins, vegetables, healthy fats; mindful carb management)
- Low-impact exercise(walking, light yoga, indoor alternatives)
- Prioritized sleep hygiene(caffeine after 3 PM, cool/dark room, reading before bed)
- Stress management(5-minute morning mindfulness, gratitude journaling)
- Daily hydration(water bottle, herbal teas)
- Preventative care(regular check-ups, vaccines, mammograms, bone density monitoring)
- Self-compassion and consistency over perfection

Core philosophy: Small, daily choices add up. Health is not about drastic changes, but about making intentional, kind decisions every day. Patient emphasizes long-term resilience, self-compassion, and adaptability—especially to Kansas weather and life’s unpredictability. This approach supports stable blood sugar, joint health, stress reduction, and overall well-being.
